reviews.comment: there are so many works. she gave us extra day if you late on work. She did "cold call" stuff which is randomly picking someone to discuss something. She is definitely a nice person, however the attendance is mandatory which is small essay things at the beggining of class. No exam but all essays

Absolutely the best professors I've ever had, the course isn't very hard but you need to put in the time because it's an English writing class, there are several essays to write, and there is a research paper at the end of the semester and you can choose any field you want to write in. Most importantly: there are a lot of extra credit chances. :)))

Lots of short assignments outside of major assignments(essays/group projects). These assignments helps tremendously in the writing process but are pretty disorganized and can get tedious at times. She is very caring and accommodating. As long as you keep up with the assignments A is very doable.
